name: warmup-wait-ready
title: TDLib chat warmup: wait-for-ready with lazy subscription
description: Replace warmup's immediate single retry with a wait-for-ready state machine: lazy updateNewChat subscription (edge as persistent closed channel), LoadChats drive via existing warmChatsOnce, level-oracle retry of fn, static deadline -> typed ErrChatNotReady -> gRPC UNAVAILABLE+RetryInfo; bundled observability fixes (chat_id=0 logging, 404 Warn->Info) and SRE's four pre-launch metrics.
creator: killbus
